breakdown.description: A number-average molecular weight smaller than the repeat-unit molecular weight, which would imply a degree of polymerization below 1 for a polymer chain.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses M_n = 7,800 g/mol instead of the incorrect 78 g/mol from the incomplete prompt. This fixes the inconsistency where M_n was smaller than M_0 (104 g/mol), which would have implied a degree of polymerization below 1. With 7,800 g/mol, the degree of polymerization is 75, which is physically meaningful.
